headline: The 189 traveled. The 24:18 cannot be the habit.
dek: Kansas City is 4-0 after a 30-27 win at Allegiant Stadium, and Kenneth Walker III's 177 rushing yards inside a 189-yard team run game meet the Chargers on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT without Tyquan Thornton.
videoHook: Walker ran for 177, the team ran for 189, and Las Vegas still held the football for 35:42. That is the tape the Chargers get on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT.
theEdge: ESPN FPI gives Kansas City a 74.1 percent chance against Los Angeles, DraftKings lists KC -8.5 on a 42.5 total, and Polymarket still prices a 9.8 percent championship ticket and a 17.5 percent AFC ticket — home chalk after Las Vegas posted 28 first downs, 365 net passing yards, and a 35:42 possession time in a three-point loss.

storyline.lede: Kansas City left Allegiant Stadium 4-0, and the scoreboard says 30-27. The film says something sharper: a 189-yard rushing day and four touchdowns were enough to outrun a Las Vegas offense that posted 28 first downs, 365 net passing yards, 437 total yards, and a 35:42 possession time. Kansas City's own line was 18 first downs, 210 net passing yards, 399 total yards, and 24:18 with the football. Andy Reid's team stole the result with Kenneth Walker III, two takeaways, and a fourth-quarter burst. It did not steal the down-and-distance game.
body: The bye did not refill the vertical. Tyquan Thornton, who caught five passes for 111 yards and two touchdowns in that win, is out on a 12-to-16-week ankle timeline. Patrick Mahomes was 15-of-30 for 225 yards and two passing touchdowns, with 2 sacks and a 97.2 rating, and the team net was 210. Those two passing scores are Thornton's two receiving scores. Xavier Worthy still has the 41-yard catch on the tape. Travis Kelce and Noah Gray each had two catches. That is a real room, and it is a thinner one than the one that just won a road division game.

Steve Spagnuolo's defense recorded 10 quarterback hits and did not sack Kirk Cousins, who was 31-of-52 with 0 sacks and an 85.8 rating. Ashton Jeanty touched the ball 21 times. Brock Bowers caught six passes, including the 20-yard touchdown that made it 30-27 after a successful two-point throw to Cody White. Las Vegas also made four field goals. Give that offense real credit. The Chiefs won because Las Vegas turned it over twice, rushed for 72 yards, and could not match Walker's 22-carry, 177-yard, two-touchdown day inside a 26-carry, 189-yard team rush.

Week 6 is the correction window, not a coronation. Los Angeles comes to GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT. ESPN FPI has Kansas City at 74.1 percent. The championship price has not caught the power rankings. The assignment is to keep Walker's identity, give Mahomes easier answers without Thornton, and keep Justin Herbert from living in the clean, high-volume pocket Cousins just had. After that, Sun Oct 25, 7:20 PM CT at Seattle and Sun Nov 1, 3:25 PM CT at Denver are already on the card.

lastGameReview.label: Week 4 · Sun, Oct 4 · 3:25 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City beat the Raiders 30-27 at Allegiant Stadium on Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT. Las Vegas scored a 27-yard touchdown at game clock Q1 8:10 and led 0-7. Kansas City answered, traded field goals to trail 10-13 at the half, put up no points in the third quarter, then ripped off the fourth-quarter sequence that made it 30-19 before Brock Bowers' 20-yard touchdown and a successful two-point conversion left it at 30-27. An interception by X. Nwankpa ended it.

analysis.body: The rushing identity was the clean part of the tape. Kenneth Walker III carried 22 times for 177 yards and two rushing touchdowns, with one catch, 23 touches in all. The team rushed 26 times for 189 yards. The play-by-play names his 22-yard touchdown at Q4 3:02 as a right-end score, and it moved the board from 23-19 to 30-19 after Harrison Butker's extra point. Earlier carries show up the middle and off left end, including an 11-yard left-end gain in the second quarter. Kareem Tonga, Matt Araiza, and Mahomes supplied the other four rushes. Araiza's came from punt formation, right end, for 12 yards. On the Q1 11:29 snap, Hunter Nourzad and Tonga reported eligible and Tonga went up the middle for no gain. That is a different report from the Q1 6:01 snap, when Tonga reported eligible and Mahomes scrambled right end for 1 yard.

Mahomes was 15-of-30 for 225 yards, two touchdowns, 2 sacks, and a 97.2 rating. Team net passing was 210. Las Vegas recorded 8 quarterback hits on him. The explosives were real and they were not play-action labels: a 41-yard completion to Xavier Worthy down to the Las Vegas 7, a 42-yard completion to Tyquan Thornton down to the 5, and a 55-yard completion to Thornton down to the 5 at Q4 3:35. Thornton was injured on that 55-yard play, and a Quinton Walker unnecessary-roughness foul was enforced from the 5. The series reached a 2-yard Kansas City touchdown at Q4 3:21, and the score was 23-19. Thornton finished with five catches, 111 yards, and two touchdowns. Worthy had four catches. Kelce and Gray had two apiece. Third down was 5-13. A first-quarter drive died on downs when Walker went up the middle for 1 yard.

Las Vegas deserves the volume credit, and the takeaways have named owners. The Raiders had 28 first downs, 26 rushes for 72 yards, 365 net passing yards, 437 total yards, a 5-14 third-down line, 12 drives, and a 35:42 possession time. Kansas City had 18 first downs, 12 drives, 0 turnovers, and a 24:18 possession time. Cousins was 31-of-52 with 0 sacks. Kansas City recorded 10 quarterback hits. Jeanty had 21 touches. Michael Mayer caught eight passes. Ian Thomas caught the 27-yard touchdown at Q1 8:10. Bowers caught the 20-yard touchdown at Q4 1:46. Las Vegas made four field goals: 32, 48, 44, and 48 yards. The two Las Vegas turnovers were a kickoff fumble forced by J. Bassa and recovered by J. Cochrane, and the interception by X. Nwankpa on a pass intended for Mayer. Maxx Crosby was in on an incompletion to Thornton in the third quarter. Late flags mattered on the Bowers drive: Felix Anudike-Uzomah was called for roughing the passer at Q4 2:38, a no-play, and L. Sneed was called for defensive holding at Q4 2:10, also a wiped play. Kansas City also kept its own fumble at Q4 1:35, recovered by Mahomes after a Creed Humphrey mishandle, so the box stays at 0 turnovers.

takeaways.title: Walker was the offense that traveled
takeaways.body: Twenty-two carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, and 23 touches inside a 189-yard team rushing day. The 22-yard right-end score at Q4 3:02 is the one the play-by-play names. That identity is what a thinner receiver room can actually lean on.

takeaways.title: Volume lost, turnovers won
takeaways.body: Las Vegas had the football for 35:42, posted 28 first downs, and threw for 365 net yards. Kansas City had it for 24:18 and still won because the Raiders turned it over twice: fumble forced by J. Bassa and recovered by J. Cochrane, and the interception by X. Nwankpa.

takeaways.title: The passing day was explosive and incomplete
takeaways.body: Mahomes at 15-of-30 for 225 yards, two touchdowns, and 2 sacks is a winning line and a volatile one. Eight quarterback hits and a 5-13 third-down rate are the parts that do not get a pass just because the rating was 97.2.

takeaways.title: Thornton's exit is already on the tape
takeaways.body: The 55-yard catch at Q4 3:35 was also the injury play. Five catches, 111 yards, and two touchdowns do not walk into Week 6 with him.

whatWorked: Kenneth Walker III: 22 carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, 23 touches, inside a team rush of 189 on 26 attempts.
Zero Kansas City turnovers, plus the fumble forced by J. Bassa and recovered by J. Cochrane and the interception by X. Nwankpa.
Explosive completions that the play-by-play actually shows: Worthy for 41, Thornton for 42, Thornton for 55.
Matt Araiza's punt-formation right-end run for 12, and five punts inside the 20 on the way to AFC special-teams honors.
whatDidnt: Third down at 5-13, with a first-quarter drive dying on downs on a 1-yard Walker carry up the middle.
Mahomes at 15-of-30, 2 sacks, and 8 quarterback hits, with team net passing at 210.
Las Vegas possession time of 35:42, 28 Las Vegas first downs, and 365 Las Vegas net passing yards, with Cousins at 31-of-52 and 0 sacks despite 10 Kansas City quarterback hits.
Late flags: N. Williams for unnecessary roughness and defensive holding, Anudike-Uzomah for roughing the passer, and L. Sneed for defensive holding.

currentState.lede: The Chiefs are 4-0, nearly unanimous No. 2 in the Week 6 power-rankings roundup, and still priced like a sample: 9.8 percent to win the championship and 17.5 percent to win the AFC on Polymarket. The Allegiant win was real. The habits inside it — 24:18 of possession, 5-13 on third down, a receiver who just left for 12 to 16 weeks — are the work before Los Angeles walks into Arrowhead.

workOn.title: Third down without the 111-yard receiver
workOn.body: A 5-13 day was survivable because Thornton and Worthy hit explosives and Walker finished. Thornton is out. Eric Bieniemy needs defined answers on third-and-medium for Kelce, Gray, Worthy, and Cyrus Allen, whom Andy Reid said will work in a little bit more.

workOn.title: Turn 10 hits into a finished rush
workOn.body: Kansas City recorded 10 quarterback hits. Kirk Cousins was 31-of-52 with 0 sacks. Justin Herbert cannot be allowed the same clean, high-attempt pocket. The rush has to change the picture, not just arrive late.

workOn.title: Late-flag discipline
workOn.body: Anudike-Uzomah's roughing call and L. Sneed's holding call wiped plays on the drive that ended in a 20-yard Bowers touchdown and a two-point conversion. A 30-19 lead became 30-27. That is a coaching point, not a footnote.

workOn.title: Left guard clarity before the Chargers
workOn.body: Mike Caliendo started the entire Raiders game at left guard. Reid says Kingsley Suamataia will be back in. Mahomes took 2 sacks and 8 hits. Whoever starts has to be decided before Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT, not during it.

thinkAbout.title: No. 2 in the rankings, 9.8 percent for the title
thinkAbout.body: Arrowhead Pride's Week 6 roundup has the Chiefs nearly unanimous at No. 2, ESPN unchanged. Polymarket has not moved them into a coronation. A 6-11 season is history. A 30-27 win with 24:18 of possession is the live sample the price is still taxing.

thinkAbout.title: How much of the air game was Thornton
thinkAbout.body: He led the wideouts in receiving yards at 219 and in touchdowns at 2 before the ankle dislocation. Week 4 was five catches for 111 and two scores. Worthy’s 41-yard catch is the explosive that is still in the building. The staff has to decide whether Allen, a practice-squad Justin Watson, and Kelce can replace the vertical or whether the run game has to cover the gap.

thinkAbout.title: What the safety room just showed
thinkAbout.body: X. Nwankpa intercepted the pass intended for Mayer. Mansoor Delane led the team with 10 tackles. Arrowhead Addict is already arguing for a bigger Nwankpa role after the bye. Spagnuolo can expand the role without pretending one interception is a full-time job.

gamePlan.lede: Host Los Angeles on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, CBS, as an 8.5-point favorite on a 42.5 total. The assignment is to make this a Walker game and a two-deep game, not a repeat of the volume Las Vegas just posted. Stakes are divisional: Arrowhead Pride's frame is a chance to squeeze the AFC West across the next three weeks, starting here, with Denver waiting on Sun Nov 1, 3:25 PM CT after Seattle.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Kansas City brings a 4-0, a 189-yard rushing identity, and a quarterback who just won on 15-of-30. The Chiefs' receiver room is the soft edge. Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks. The Chargers' problem is the same one every West opponent has now: Walker at 6.2 yards per carry and 621 yards from scrimmage on the season, per the Arrowhead Pride comparison. Edge rush versus Mahomes is live too. He was sacked twice and hit eight times at Allegiant, with Crosby among the rushers who got home on a third-quarter incompletion.

keys.title: Steal the early downs on the ground
keys.body: Walker at 22 carries and 177 yards is the call sheet, not a souvenir. Stay out of 3rd-and-long. A 5-13 third-down rate cannot be the plan against a quarterback who can hold the ball the way Cousins did.

keys.title: Easy answers for a thinner room
keys.body: Boot, mesh, and the screen. Kelce, Gray, Worthy, and Allen have to win with structure. Do not ask a 15-of-30 profile to become a 30-attempt hero script with Thornton on the shelf.

keys.title: Two-deep, then change the picture
keys.body: Las Vegas scored touchdowns of 27 and 20 yards and still made four field goals. Cover-2 takes the shot. A zone blitz is the third-down call so 10 hits are not the whole pass-rush story again.

keys.title: Pin them and steal a short field
keys.body: Araiza just put all five punts inside the 20 and won AFC special-teams honors. The kickoff fumble forced by J. Bassa and recovered by J. Cochrane became Walker's 22-yard touchdown. Field position is a weapon this defense can use.

script: Open under center with Walker on early downs. The team rush was 189. Let that be the first statement before Herbert's offense gets a rhythm.
On 2nd-and-medium, boot Mahomes off the run fake toward Kelce in the flat and Worthy on the cross. Pocket movement is the answer to 2 sacks and 8 hits, not a label on any Allegiant throw.
Third-and-medium: mesh for Kelce and Gray, with Allen clearing and Walker as the checkdown. Reid already said Allen works in more.
If the edge crashes, throw the Walker screen. He had one catch on 23 touches. That is unused, not a flaw.

Defensively, start in Cover-2. On third down, simulate pressure: show heat, drop a lineman, rush the second level. The goal is a hurried Herbert, separate from how the interception by X. Nwankpa happened.
Finish drives. Four Kansas City touchdowns and one Kansas City field goal won a game Las Vegas kept alive with four field goals. Red-zone walks have to be touchdowns at home as an 8.5-point favorite.

nextGame.label: Week 6 · Sun, Oct 18 · 3:25 PM CT
nextGame.note: AFC West home game, Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT. Favorite on the sheet, thinner at receiver, still 4-0.

spotlight.title: Walker against the old standard
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride has him at 621 yards from scrimmage, six total touchdowns, and 6.2 yards per carry through the opening month. Week 4 was the loudest chapter: 22 carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, 23 touches, inside a 189-yard team day.

spotlight.title: The Thornton clock is months, not days
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride, citing Ian Rapoport, has the ankle dislocation at 12 to 16 weeks. He led Chiefs wideouts in receiving yards at 219 and in touchdowns at 2. The rotation adjusts now, not after the Chargers.

spotlight.title: Araiza's five-for-five inside the 20
spotlight.body: Chiefs.com named him AFC Special Teams Player of the Week after he placed all five punts inside the 20. The punt-formation right-end run for 12 is extra tape, not one of those five punts.

spotlight.title: Nwankpa is on the tape for a reason
spotlight.body: The interception by X. Nwankpa closed Allegiant. Delane had 10 tackles. Arrowhead Addict wants a bigger role after the bye. Spagnuolo can grow the snaps without rewriting who made the play.

spotlight.title: Three weeks that can squeeze the West
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride's frame is a stranglehold window: Chargers at Arrowhead, then the road, including Denver on Sun Nov 1, 3:25 PM CT. Seattle sits in between on Sun Oct 25, 7:20 PM CT. Win the division game in front of you before you inventory the rest.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run game vs. Chargers front
matchups.chiefs: Kenneth Walker III, 22 carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns; team rush 189 on 26
matchups.opponent: A Chargers front that has not seen this 2026 Walker yet
matchups.note: The identity is already on film. Early downs are how Kansas City stays out of the 5-13 third-down box.

matchups.chiefs: 15-of-30, 225 yards, 2 sacks, 8 quarterback hits, team net 210
matchups.opponent: Whatever edge Los Angeles sends, with the Crosby pressure at Allegiant as the recent warning
matchups.note: The rating was 97.2 and the ball-security line was clean. The hit chart was not. Boot and screen are the plan, not a shrug.

matchups.chiefs: 10 quarterback hits; Cousins was 31-of-52 with 0 sacks
matchups.opponent: Justin Herbert, with a Raiders air script of 365 net passing yards sitting on film
matchups.note: Hits without a sack are a warning, not a compliment. Change the picture on third down.

matchups.chiefs: Thornton out; Worthy four catches including a 41-yarder; Kelce and Gray at two catches each; Allen working in more
matchups.opponent: A secondary that can sit on a thinner vertical
matchups.note: Until Allen, Watson, Worthy, and Kelce prove the explosives travel, this is the soft edge of a 4-0 team.

matchups.chiefs: Araiza, five punts inside the 20; Butker's kickoff, fumble forced by J. Bassa and recovered by J. Cochrane
matchups.opponent: A Chargers return unit that just watched that short field become a 22-yard touchdown
matchups.note: Field position is the cheapest way to keep Herbert off a 35:42-style possession script. That 35:42 belonged to Las Vegas, not to Kansas City.

xsandos.title: Walker downhill on early downs
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 and 2nd-and-short against the Chargers, before a 5-13 third-down profile can reappear
xsandos.why: Walker's 22-carry, 177-yard day is the early-down steal, so Los Angeles cannot sit in two-deep and make a thinner receiver room win from behind.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy lives under center. Zone steps, one cut, Walker presses and bends. The team rush was 189 on 26 attempts. If that look is there, Mahomes does not need another 30-attempt afternoon.

xsandos.title: Boot off the Walker sell
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-medium after a successful run look, pocket movement after 2 sacks and 8 hits on Mahomes
xsandos.why: Sell the 189-yard run game, move Mahomes to the perimeter, and give Kelce and Worthy defined throws while Thornton is out.
xsandos.coaching: The fake has to carry Walker's path. Mahomes exits to the boot side, Kelce settles in the flat, Worthy crosses intermediate, and Allen occupies the deep corner so the read stays defined.

xsandos.title: Mesh for the room without Thornton
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-4 to 3rd-and-6 against man, the down Kansas City converted 5 of 13 at Allegiant
xsandos.why: Thornton's five-catch, 111-yard, two-touchdown day is gone for 12 to 16 weeks, so separation has to be manufactured for Kelce, Gray, Worthy, and Allen.
xsandos.coaching: Rub the crossers. Kelce and Gray mesh, Worthy sits the corner, Allen is the vertical clear, and Walker is the checkdown. Mahomes throws the first open window.

xsandos.title: Walker screen to quiet the hits
xsandos.situation: After a crash look, or 2nd-and-long, so Mahomes is not living in another eight-hit script
xsandos.why: Walker had one catch on 23 touches while Mahomes took 8 quarterback hits and 2 sacks. The screen lets the line lead and turns that rush into space.
xsandos.coaching: Alert it when the edge crashes. Walker aims for the perimeter, Gray and the tackle lead, and the ball is out before the second hitter arrives. Easy offense, on purpose.

xsandos.title: Two-deep against the explosive
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 and after a chunk, the situations where Las Vegas hit a 27-yard touchdown and a 20-yard touchdown
xsandos.why: Las Vegas posted 365 net passing yards and 28 first downs. Two deep halves take the shot away and let Delane and the underneath rally to tackle.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo splits the safeties in the deep halves and sinks the corners before they rally. The Thomas 27-yard score and the Bowers 20-yard score are the pictures to erase. Tackle in the five-under.

xsandos.title: Simulated pressure on third down
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-6 to 3rd-and-10, when Herbert wants to hold the ball the way Cousins did on 52 attempts
xsandos.why: Kansas City recorded 10 quarterback hits and Cousins finished with 0 sacks. Show heat, drop a lineman, and rush the second level so the picture is not a clean pocket.
xsandos.coaching: This is a call for Arrowhead. Karlaftis can stem and drop while a second-level rusher replaces him. The aim is a hurried throw and a rally tackle. The interception by X. Nwankpa stays its own play.

coaching.topic: Reid on the lineup he actually named
coaching.detail: After the bye he said Kingsley Suamataia will be back in, Cyrus Allen will work into the offense a little bit more, and Justin Watson is coming to the practice squad. Those are the available answers. Thornton is not one of them.

The run game produced 189 yards and Walker produced 177 of them. The passing game produced explosives and a 15-of-30 line. The install is early-down runs plus defined third-down answers, not another hope that a 55-yard shot bails out the down.

Ten quarterback hits, Cousins at 0 sacks, and two late wiped plays from Anudike-Uzomah and L. Sneed. Cover-2 plus a zone blitz is the Herbert plan. The takeaways already have their credits: J. Bassa forced, J. Cochrane recovered, X. Nwankpa intercepted.

injuries.note: Ankle dislocation, 12-to-16-week timeline, per Ian Rapoport of NFL Network as cited by Arrowhead Pride. He was injured on the 55-yard catch at Q4 3:35. Week 4 line: 5 receptions, 111 yards, 2 touchdowns.
Arrowhead Addict frames Kahlil Benson's role as one that could evolve once Simmons returns, so the tackle is not in the current starting picture. No diagnosis beyond that framing is on this wire.

personnel.move: Justin Watson to the practice squad
personnel.detail: Reid announced the signing after the bye. Arrowhead Addict reads it as familiarity over a bigger swing, a poor-man's Thornton rather than a roster earthquake.
Reid said Allen will work into the offense a little bit more. He was already targeted on a deep incompletion at Allegiant. The Thornton absence makes that more than a camp line.

personnel.move: Suamataia back in at left guard
personnel.detail: Caliendo started the entire Raiders game at left guard. Reid said the details stay between him and Suamataia, and that Suamataia will be back in. Mahomes was hit 8 times and sacked twice behind that line.
Arrowhead Pride notes Houston sent a 2027 second and a sixth to Arizona for Harrison and a seventh. The Chiefs' wire response was Watson and Allen, not that trade.

strategies: Live on early-down inside zone for Walker so a 5-13 third-down rate does not meet Herbert.
Boot Mahomes off the run fake to cut the 8-hit, 2-sack chart down to defined perimeter throws.
Mesh and the checkdown on third-and-medium for Kelce, Gray, Worthy, and Allen.
Throw the Walker screen when the edge crashes. One catch on 23 touches is unused production.
Start in Cover-2 so a 27-yard and a 20-yard touchdown are not the template Las Vegas just left on film.
Call the zone blitz on third down so 10 quarterback hits are attached to a changed picture, with Cousins' 0-sack line as the warning.
debates: Is 15-of-30 a Mahomes problem, or the profile of an offense that just lost its 111-yard receiver?
Should Suamataia start immediately, or did Caliendo earn another week after playing every snap at Allegiant?
Can Allen and a practice-squad Watson cover Thornton's vertical before Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT, or does Walker have to be the entire offense?
Does Spagnuolo need more simulated pressure after 10 hits and a Cousins line of 31-of-52 with 0 sacks?
Are you buying the No. 2 ranking or the 9.8 percent championship price?

runOfShow.talkTrack: Walker ran for 177. The team ran for 189. Kansas City possessed the ball for 24:18. Las Vegas possessed it for 35:42 and still lost 30-27. That gap is the show.

Walk the scoring order with the clocks. Las Vegas touchdown at Q1 8:10, 0-7. Kansas City touchdown at Q1 2:23, 7-7. Four Las Vegas field goals in the game, one Kansas City field goal. Fourth quarter: 17-13, 17-16, 17-19, 23-19, then Walker's 22-yard right-end touchdown to 30-19, then Bowers from 20 with the two-point to White, 30-27. Credit the fumble to J. Bassa forcing and J. Cochrane recovering. Credit the interception to X. Nwankpa.

Third down 5-13. Mahomes 15-of-30, 2 sacks, 8 hits, team net passing 210. Thornton out 12 to 16 weeks. Suamataia coming back in. Watson on the practice squad. Rankings say No. 2. Polymarket says 9.8 percent and 17.5 percent. Hold both ideas at once.

Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT, Arrowhead, CBS. FPI 74.1 percent, DraftKings KC -8.5, total 42.5. Keys: Walker early, easy throws for Kelce and Worthy, Cover-2, and a zone blitz that is a call, not a takeaway credit. Herbert does not get Cousins' clean 52-attempt pocket.
Home favorite is a price. The habit to kill is winning while the other team holds it for 35:42. That clock was Las Vegas. Kansas City's was 24:18. Next Sunday has to look different.
